hero.title: Every order arrives ready to cut.
hero.description: Made-to-measure and bespoke orders come with the customer's measurements, locked at order time, along with the set they used and how it was taken. Their contact details stay private; on bespoke orders you talk in the order's chat.

needs.title: Know what to confirm before you cut
needs.description: Customers can't order a made-to-measure piece until every measurement it needs is in. On the order, numbers worth checking are marked Verify, with a note of what to confirm for that garment.
points: The measurements each garment needs, checked at checkout
Extras you may want, listed for you

ask.title: Something look off? Ask the customer
ask.description: Ask about any measurement from the order. The customer gets a notification and an email, and their answer corrects the numbers for that order.
points: Pick the measurements and write your question
See exactly what changed, like Waist 80 → 82
Made-to-order pieces can't be returned, so checking pays

production.title: Show them the finished piece
production.description: Photograph the finished piece and send it for approval. The customer approves and pays the balance before you ship, or tells you what to change.
points: Up to 8 photos and a note
Changes caught before it ships, not after
Balance paid before it leaves your workshop

quote.title: Quote with the whole brief in front of you
quote.description: Quote requests arrive with the design, front and back, the styles and the customer's measurements. Add your line items, the fabric you need and the days until you ship.
points: Agree to the bespoke terms once, in the quote
The customer pays a deposit when they accept

conversion.title: Make it right the first time.
conversion.description: Join the vendor waitlist and get orders that arrive with everything you need to cut.

image.alt: High tech tailoring and measurement visualization
